instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: There were <mat>56</mat> words in the spelling test. Nathan scored <mat>75%</mat>. How many words did he write correctly?
Jerry has a big jar of jelly beans with <mat>200</mat> in it. He wants to give <mat>11%</mat> of the jelly beans to a friend. How many jelly beans does his friend get?
Siobhan has 40 apples. <mat>5%</mat> of the apples are rotten. How many apples are rotten?
<mat>4000</mat> ants live in one colony. It is expected that the population will grow by <mat>12%</mat> in the next year. How many ants will the ant colony grow by?
atoms.b: The ant colony will grow by <mat><gap>480</gap></mat> members.

atoms.a: Sarah has spent <mat>40%</mat> of her <mat>£25</mat> this month already. How much money has she spent?
Brian and Cassandra have already run <mat>57%</mat> of their 7-mile run. How many miles of their run have they already completed?
atoms.b: Brian and Cassandra have already run <mat><gap>3.99</gap></mat> miles.
